name: Hatfield Squat
instructions: Set a safety squat bar in a rack at about the height of your upper chest. Set the safety pins just below the depth you will squat to.
Put the yoke on your upper back and unrack the bar. Let the bar handles hang free in front of you. Do not hold them.
Put your hands on the rack uprights, on a second bar set at about waist height, or on handles fixed to the rack.
Keep your torso upright and squat down as deep as you can with good form. Use your hands only for balance.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand. If you are stuck, push lightly with your hands to get through the sticking point, but do not pull down on the rack.
